title: Roman doctors still grant: even ‘venial’ sins in those dying outside grace meet eternal penalties justly
source_text: LVIII. Inde quoque manifestum est eosdem Scholae Romanae Doctores non ne-gare, quin omnia peccata, adeoque illa ipsa quae venialia dicuntur, in iis qui extra Dei gratiam vitam finiunt, aeternis poenis plecti possint, & talibus poenis de facto puniantur, & quidem justissime, & juxta Dei judicium, quod est secundum verita-tem.
pass_a_gloss: Thence also it is manifest that the same Doctors of the Roman School do not deny that all sins, and so those very ones which are called venial, in those who finish life outside God’s grace, can be punished with eternal penalties, and are in fact punished with such penalties, and that most justly, and according to God’s judgment which is according to truth.
pass_b_english: Rome still grants: so-called venial sins, in those who die outside grace, are justly punished forever.
Eternal penalty for the graceless end is not denied even for the ‘light’ class.
